contract_document.normalization: UTF-8 with CRLF/CR normalized to LF only; pinned source/evidence identities remain raw-byte SHA-256.

rules: Separate private reservation reader from immutable source reads; derive only platform_reservation from validated RecorderBinding.
Require current admitted owner and supervisor RESERVED. Build exact expected record from original attempt/profile/run/source/authorization/review bindings before reading.
Use existing private WindowsFiles verification open mode, read-only and OPEN_EXISTING; keep supervisor writer retained, unchanged and exclusively owned. No backend change.

Check pinned parent, exact byte extent, native file identity equal to the held supervisor file, full contents and SHA-256, then unchanged native identity. Identity statement alone is not owner provenance.
Retain reader in its own close ledger; exactly one close attempt per acquired handle. No retry, fallback path, write, rename, early writer release or public reader.
static_acceptance: Every reservation-read callsite selects the private role-bound reader, not read_source's default sharing mode.
The actual access/share tuple is compatible with the retained writer and cannot enable foreign writes/deletes while it is held.
Identity, original bytes, owner, phase and close obligations are explicit; every operation is included in FG-C02.

rules: Separate arithmetic checking from independently admitted source/loop/schema proof; accepting a row digest or assumption string does not accept its truth.
Bind every row to source FileRef, qualified site, call edge, process role, phase, branch, unit, input evidence, multiplicity proof, primitive rule and derived cost.
Resolve the complete reachable call graph and justify exclusions. Unknown dynamic targets, unbounded loops and unexplained zero costs block.

Count explicit native calls, logical call pairs, proxies, validation, encoding, decoding, source reads, held handles and exceptional cleanup separately, with no omissions or ambiguous double counting.
Cover all process roles, helper/drain threads, bootstrap, capture, control spool, shutdown and any second exceptional postcondition pass.
Derive exact source/fixture/trace/raw/transcript/control/bootstrap extents from bounded schemas, including one-byte fragments, full Base64/JSON envelopes and concurrent copies.
Payload extents are not total process memory or CPU time. Runtime/library/object-overhead assumptions and host resources require distinct admission.
Budget graph is acyclic; final serialized bytes may validate an earlier bound but never increase it. Fixed-width digests and prebounded integer widths prevent packet/certificate self-sizing.
Direction counters include bootstrap/header/frames from first byte through terminal return without resets. Failure output and cleanup reserve are included, not added after failure.
Materialize positive integer limits before dispatch only from complete admitted rows and host envelope. No arbitrary safety factor, run-based tuning, null executable limit or overflow.
static_acceptance: All sites and call multiplicities are source-evidenced, including non-success paths and runtime boundary summaries.
Units, role/phase totals and directional counters agree with concrete operators and original S2-FD primitive-cost rules.
Complete byte/memory/protocol/cleanup derivation and independent host approval exist; inventory alone cannot pass.
Missing final runtime/authority/packet inputs leave certificate NOT_MATERIALIZED, never implicitly accepted.

rules: An independently admitted finite BootstrapPolicy exists before input; never derive its authority or limits from the payload being bounded.
Policy binds roles, bootstrap/header/frame/total bytes, original count and per-original extents, structure/string/integer limits, memory envelope and phase deadlines.
Sender checks size and cost before Base64/JSON allocation. Receiver bounds even the eight-byte header wait and validates positive declared length including header before payload allocation.
Bound fragmented reads and structure parsing; checking maximum_ipc_bytes after full JSON/base64 decoding is insufficient.
After decode, compare package/role/source/authority and matching budget dimensions exactly with the pre-admitted policy; no payload-selected enlargement.
Count header and payload once in shared directional accounting. ParentChannel creation cannot reset totals/deadlines. No blocking fallback, EOF-based replacement or retry.
static_acceptance: Every allocating/decoding/reading path is dominated by independently rooted, already available limits.
Bounded pre-parse structure checks and complete bootstrap memory/framing costs are materializable.
Policy provenance and its finite delivery are included in FG-C04/FG-C05; missing policy blocks before payload.

rules: Persisted dispatch/seal are consumption evidence only, not replayable authorization.
External trusted admission precedes payload handling; no JSON, CLI, environment, START/OWNED word, newly created ContextVar or submitted PID/handle establishes it.
Live owner binds attempt, package/admission/policy/source closure, held channels and independently admitted observer creation identity.
One shared atomic per-role claim ledger is owned by that live owner. UNUSED -> CLAIMED before Popen; CLAIMED -> SPAWNED -> TERMINAL or FAILED/UNKNOWN; never reset or retry.
Fresh ChildOwner objects cannot create a new role budget. Preserve observer/starter/supervisor/worker hierarchy and one instance per child role.
Current outer owner authorization precedes each spawn. Real child process adoption precedes gate release; worker additionally requires RESERVED and FG-C01.
Parent/channel identity must match independently expected live authority, not values learned solely from the same submitted message.
Direct/replayed child entry without this chain rejects before another spawn, reservation or recorder gate. Owner loss/unknown consumption denies reconstruction.
Keep existing attempt and two fixed owner paths; no new ledger path, service, cryptographic scheme or privileged launcher is selected by this contract.
static_acceptance: Trace an independent trust anchor to each role claim, real channel and actual process identity before any side effect.
Static re-entry reasoning must show old handoff bytes and fresh ChildOwner instances cannot claim an already consumed role.
Identify concrete trusted bootstrap delivery and its source/runtime/budget evidence; a hypothetical safe transport does not pass.
Unadmitted owner transport remains a materialization blocker. No arbitrary-code-injection or compromised-OS protection is claimed.

rules: Require exact S2-FB layout-contract FileRef inherited from S2-FD, not arbitrary membership in historical refs.
Relate every process interpreter FileRef, architecture/ABI and runtime dependencies to the same admitted SourceManifest.runtime_identity.
Close actual entry, package initializers, private and recorder sources, bootstrap/stdlib/extensions/runtime dependencies using FileRefs and import edges or explicit built-in provenance.
Unknown dynamic imports block; no external project imports, automatic downloads or invented runtime refs.
Admitted parent must protect source/runtime identity before child import and retain that proof through completion. Child SourceLease is a recheck, not retroactive provenance.
Keep external runtime reading separate from repository-only read_source.
Preserve archived metadata; independently establish fourth parent, durability basis and intended runtime admission. Matching hashes/reviewer names do not replace substantive evidence.
static_acceptance: Exact layout role and interpreter/runtime relations are validated, not merely nonempty refs.
Full bootstrap closure and protection from pre-import to completion are source-traceable and independently admitted.
Runtime, parent and durability evidence gaps remain explicit; historical observer metadata is not promoted to current recorder proof.

rules: Preserve primary cause, phase, origin role/operation/code, native error when known and all cleanup errors. Do not discard abort() return values.

Already swallowed cleanup evidence is UNKNOWN, never successful. If existing operators cannot expose it through the private boundary, keep the code blocker open; no existing-core change is authorized.
Classify by observed cause and phase with the bound status precedence, not only exception class.
Represent unavailable package/owner identity honestly with null plus missing evidence; never generate a plausible digest for invalid input.
Use separately closed FailureEvidence, ClosureEvidence and TerminalEvidence forms; they are normative not implemented and do not silently extend existing V1 records.
Differentiate owned OS observations from delegated source-bound closure evidence. Preserve existing control.finish-before-success order and exact source/operator provenance.
Never derive pipe/control close success merely from process exit, readable files or a global success Boolean.
Independent caller separately observes observer termination. Observer return cannot contain evidence of its own later exit.
Bound complete diagnostics, evidence lists and cleanup work by FG-C02; no silent truncation, publication retry or success from partial evidence.
static_acceptance: Every validation, setup, body, abort, cleanup and no-return branch reaches a defined external terminal assessment without promoting missing evidence.
Returned cleanup tuples and native prerequisite failures retain cause and precedence.
Success requires valid original receipts, native child exits and closures, admitted delegated operations and separate actual observer exit.
Private encoding/version adoption is explicit and closed; the unchanged current code cannot be assumed to accept these forms.

proof_shapes.representation_rule: These describe required proof content. No implementation, source function, executable start policy or authorization object is created. Further audit must bind any concrete transport/schema adoption explicitly.

fields.creation_filetime: Exact uint64 native process creation time
fields.image_path: Canonical path equal to admitted interpreter FileRef

CreationIdentity.rule: Acquired through a retained native process handle; a supplied matching dictionary is not authority.

fields.input_bounds: Exact integers with original evidence refs
fields.derived_cost: Exact integer from inputs and rule
fields.assumption_admission_ref: Independent acceptance of this precise source/row set

BudgetDerivationObligation.rule: All required domains are independently covered. This is an obligation shape, not an executed budget-row instance or extension silently accepted by current v1.

required_content: exact source closure and child roles
original count and per-original byte bounds
bound policy digest and independent delivery provenance
BootstrapPolicy.rule: Available before payload/JSON/materialization and itself finite. Values require FG-C02 derivation. Incoming package can only match, never enlarge or authenticate the policy.

LiveOwnerContext.serialization_rule: Not constructible as authority from submitted bytes. Digests may describe it but do not establish its live ownership.
LiveOwnerContext.transition_rule: Consume UNUSED -> CLAIMED before spawn. Then SPAWNED -> TERMINAL or FAILED/UNKNOWN. No role recreation, rollback, respawn or reconstruction from persisted handoff.
LiveOwnerContext.materialization: Independent transport/anchor not yet admitted; remain blocked if its origin cannot be established within existing private scope.

fields.schema_version: Exact literal for the named form
fields.start_package_digest: SHA256 or null only if unavailable
fields.owner_identity: CreationIdentity or null only if unavailable
fields.operation: Nonempty bounded string naming actual operation
fields.origin: BINDING | PREREQUISITE | NATIVE | CLEANUP | IPC | BUDGET | UNKNOWN
fields.original_code: Bounded string or null if not available
fields.native_error: Exact uint32 or null if not available
fields.detail: Bounded UTF-8 diagnostic, not an authority or missing-evidence substitute

rules: Unavailable facts are listed by field name in enclosing TerminalEvidence.missing_evidence.
No booleans as integers; native code is not inferred from arbitrary text.
Do not overwrite primary failure with cleanup failure; preserve both in terminal evidence.

fields.schema_version: Exact literal for the named form
fields.resource_role: Exact role from admitted resource inventory
fields.subject_identity: Exact native identity matching the relevant owned resource
fields.operation_receipt_digest: SHA256 of original owned-operation evidence or null if missing

rules: CONFIRMED requires original operation evidence and valid role/source/owner/subject relations.
DIRECT_OS denotes evidence held by the reporting owner; receiving its serialization does not make it a direct observation of the receiver.
DELEGATED_SOURCE_BOUND additionally requires admitted source ordering and authenticated live role/channel provenance.
A global success Boolean, EOF alone or process termination cannot confirm explicit file-close success.
No new file path for this evidence. It is carried within the bounded private terminal channel.

fields.schema_version: Exact literal for the named form
fields.start_package_digest: SHA256 or null on pre-validation failure
fields.missing_evidence: Unique bounded list of exact unavailable field/role names
fields.process_observations: Ordered bounded list of original S2-FD process observations, preserving unknowns
fields.original_receipt_refs: Unique bounded list of original FileRefs; no forged absent files
fields.status: One of existing six terminal statuses

rules: Canonical digest covers all nested evidence; no cycle to an enclosing record.
Success requires no failures or missing evidence, all three valid child process identities/exits, original recording receipts and accepted closures.
This record cannot assert the reporter's own future terminal exit.
If no valid record can be emitted, external caller must retain no-return/unknown evidence and deny success.
Explicit private version handling required; current V1 validators are not assumed to accept this form.

fields.schema_version: Exact literal for the named form
fields.terminal_evidence_digest: SHA256 or null if no valid return
fields.observer_exit_code: Actual uint32 or null if unknown

rules: Produced only by independent caller with actual process/channel ownership.
CONFIRMED requires observer exit 0, complete valid returned terminal evidence and confirmed EOF/owned-handle close.
A returned successful TerminalEvidence is necessary but insufficient for final completion.
No record depends on its own future exit or hashes this caller record into the earlier observer return.

closed_form_rules: All fields required; reject extra/duplicate fields and type coercion. Null only where explicitly allowed.
Canonical JSON uses sorted keys, ensure_ascii=true, compact comma/colon separators, UTF-8, no floats/NaN for the integer-only bound forms.
All lists, strings and object cardinalities bounded by independently admitted FG-C02/FG-C03 limits before expensive handling. No bounds are materialized in this contract.
FileRef retains exact path, byte_count and raw_sha256; native identity shapes must match the existing validated resource type.
New evidence forms stay outside unchanged public/field/recorder schemas. No implicit backward compatibility or in-place reinterpretation.
Instance data, diagnostics, proof records and their encoding/validation costs are included in the future budget; no free out-of-band evidence path.

status_precedence.when: Any close/flush/seal or terminal-owner outcome failed or unknown
Role/attempt already or ambiguously consumed; no new child
Independent prerequisite missing before dispatch/child start
Dispatched/running invocation aborted by timeout, budget or other error with no higher-priority uncertainty
Observer has the complete valid pre-return chain with no failures or missing evidence; this is only its candidate result, not proof of its own later exit

failure_rules.final_caller_acceptance: Final completion requires both a valid successful TerminalEvidence and independent CallerCompletionEvidence with actual observer exit 0, confirmed EOF and owned-handle close. The later caller evidence is never a prerequisite for constructing the earlier observer record and is never hashed into it.
failure_rules.native_error_5: Before begun reservation and with no ambiguous persistence: BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE for absent rights; never elevate. During unconfirmed persistence/close: COMPLETION_UNCONFIRMED. Preserve phase and original code.
failure_rules.unknown_consumption: Denies retry even if no disk evidence exists. Record uncertainty, not a fictitious durable reservation.
failure_rules.unavailable_error_evidence: Missing or internally swallowed cleanup result means UNKNOWN, not success. If the unchanged core cannot supply the required evidence through private wrappers, keep blocker open.
failure_rules.multiple_errors: Retain primary failure and ordered cleanup failures; precedence selects terminal status without deleting causes.
failure_rules.before_valid_package: Null package/owner identities plus explicit missing evidence are allowed only in failure forms. No fake digest or success.
failure_rules.no_return: Independent caller records missing terminal evidence and denies completion. No recursive marker or automatic rerun.
failure_rules.cleanup: One owner per acquired native handle, one close attempt per owned handle; one termination authority per child. Preserve failed/unknown close attempts rather than retrying or treating object cleanup as proof.

noncircular_binding_order: Admit complete source/runtime/layout/parent evidence and finite schema bounds.
Bind source manifest, run and original inner authorization/review at the existing dependency level.
Derive source-located costs and schema upper extents without using the eventual packet's measured size as its own bound.
Bind certificate and packet; independent admission provides the already bounded bootstrap policy/context. Validate actual serialization against pre-existing bounds.
Consume external one-use authority and fixed dispatch/seal; bind live role claims and observed process identities afterwards, never into their own earlier source/packet hashes.
Record operations and original evidence, then terminal return; independent caller observes final exit and binds that later fact separately.

numerical_status.rule: No numeric execution certificate is claimed. Complete source, runtime, policy, authority and host proof remains necessary.

open_s2fc_prerequisites.requirement: Fourth parent.ledger established and independently admitted. Historical archive says missing; no current native recheck.
Parent-establishment and durability provenance for intended file-level completion.
Complete actual runtime and transitive bootstrap/import source closure, distinct from historical observer runtime.
Original inner execution/review bytes plus independent outer start admission.
Full noncircular start package and complete justified numeric budget certificate with admitted host envelope.
Independent invocation owner and caller-owned terminal observer completion proof.

next_audit.scope: Separate static code audit against S2-FG before further infrastructure acceptance
required_per_correction: independent provenance and complete budget evidence
next_audit.rule: No passing implementation status from an unchanged defective source. Subsequent correction needs separate authorization; code audit never authorizes tests, platform, ledger or matrix execution.

static_document_checks.method: Read-only file/hash/JSON comparison; no project imports or executable proof instantiation.

documentation_references.use: Static access/share compatibility requirement, not a native platform observation.
